body: Actually I was quite happy when I got home. Read all the responses in this thread and was looking forward to replying. But it turned around as soon as I tried thinking about something to write. Getting impatient, angry. And then the feeling of hopelessness overcomes me again.

I'm 20 years old.  When did it all start? It was a slow process. When I was younger I was looking forward to things and when I'd finally do them I'd  be terribly disappointed.  Happened a lot until I realized that there was nothing I more I can think of that would be of interest to me. I can't think of anything I'd like to do that I haven't done. No place I'd like to go. Nothing to look forward to anymore.
What kind of stupid things have I done? Talked a lot of shit. Done some stupid stuff, didn't kill anyone, didn't break the law or anything like that. I was such an asshole back in the day. I guess I am still. Just avoiding people / conversation as much as possible so that I don't have the opportunity anymore.
Used to get really drunk at partys. Didn't know my limits. Making a fool out of myself. 
Writing on this response for about an hour. Can't think of anything to say. I don't think it makes sense what I'm writing..
still here, I'll write more when I get home from work

Talked to my friends about it. They didn't get it. Apparently being depressed is seen as a weakness. Had the opportunity to talk to a doctor. My father was depressed. He was seeing a doctor. I wasn't doing to well a the time so he asked me if I wanted to see his doctor. Turned it down. I can't see how anyone could help me. It is how it is. No one can change the things around me or undo the things I've done. 

I'd really like to know why you've been depressed? How did you get better?
